senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to bring in close contact, v. רֵיעַ,]
to strike against, shatter, impair.—Part. pass. רָעוּעַ; f. רְעוּעָה; pl. רְעוּעִים, רְעוּעִין; רְעוּעוֹת impaired, defective; in a ruinous state, threatening, opp. בריא sound.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:5">Kel. III, 5</cite> <he>הר׳</he> a cracked vessel.

<cite ref="Taanit 20b:4">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מפולת שאמרו בריאות ולא ר׳</he> the falling of houses which they mention (<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:4">ib. III, 4</cite>) means the falling of sound buildings, but not of such as were out of repair; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (neut. verb) רַע, imperf. יֵרַע to be injurious, evil; רע ל־ to grieve, displease.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:18">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>בני אל ירע לך</he> my son, let it not grieve thee; a. e.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>השרוי בבית המר׳</he> he who dwells in a threatening house; Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ top <he>מְרוֹעֲרַע</he> (fr. <cite ref="T00920"><he>רִעְרֵעַ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:3">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>קנקנים מר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01614"><he>קַנְקָן</he> I</cite>. Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ top <he>מְרוֹעֲרָעִים</he> threatening buildings; a. fr.

senses.gloss: , Hithpol. הִתְרוֹעֵעַ, Nithpol. נִתְרוֹעֵעַ to be shaken, cracked, become defective.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 53b">Men. 53ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 11:16">Jer. XI, 16</cite>) <he>מקול מיליהן … נִיתְרָעֲעוּ דליותיהן וכ׳</he> from the sound of the words of the spies were the branches (young men) of Israel broken; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 289:1">Yalk. Jer. 289</cite> <he>נרתעו</he> (read: <he>נִתְרָעוּ</he>).

<cite ref="Sotah 48a">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="P01305"><he>ערה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Zephaniah 2:14">Zeph. II, 14</cite>) <he>אפי׳ בית … מִתְרוֹעֵעַ</he> even a house which lies in a thicket of cedars will be shaken; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 292:3">Yalk. Is. 292</cite> <he>מתנועע</he> (corr. acc.). Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ bot. <he>לכיפה … כיון שנִתְרוֹעֲעָה אחת מהן נִתְרוֹעֲעוּ כולן</he> like a heap of stones, when one of them is shaken (disturbed), all of them are shaken; Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ <he>שנִתְרַעְרְעָה … נִתְרַעְרְעוּ</he> (fr. <cite ref="T00921"><he>רערע</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>וכולה מִתְרוֹעַעַת</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to shake, impair. Y. Shebi. X, 39ᵈ top מֵירַע כוחן it impairs their prerogatives; ib. מוֹרַע (fr. יָרַע). Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵈ top שהוֹרַעְתָּ כחו וכ׳ whose standing thou declarest impaired in the case of an ascertained uncleanness.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8">Ex. R. s. 8</cite> <he>הֵרֵעוּ לנפשם</he> they did harm to themselves; a. e.—V. <cite ref="E00891"><he>הֲרָעָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be evil; ה׳ ל־ to displease. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5; Num. R. s. 167 וה׳ לאביו and it displeased his father; a. e.—[
, or הוֹרַע (fr. יָרַע) to be shaken, impaired.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 20b">Kidd. 20ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>ה׳ כחו</he> his prerogative is impaired, v. <cite ref="J00500"><he>יָפֶה</he></cite>.
